description: The inverse of a modulo m, the residue from 0 to m-1 with a*inverse = 1 mod m. The inverse of 3 mod 7 is 5, and the inverse of -1 mod 7 is 6. There is no inverse when a and m share a factor. m runs from 2 to 1000000000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mod-inverse
